title: Dino AI · An AI that learns on its own
description: An AI that teaches itself Chrome's dinosaur game: it reads the screen with OpenCV and learns when to jump through reinforcement learning (DQN).

title: World Cup 2026 · AI prediction
description: 2026 World Cup prediction with Elo, Dixon-Coles and XGBoost over 49k+ historical matches, plus 10,000 Monte Carlo tournament simulations.

title: Dexter · Custom AI assistants
description: Ecosystem configurator for AI agents: persistent memory, 46+ on-demand skills and MCP servers for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and more.

title: Nexo · Your WhatsApp assistant
description: Team WhatsApp CRM: shared inbox, AI you switch on per chat, no-code agents and flows, and a live ERP connection.

title: Lumen · Ask your numbers
description: Conversational BI: voice or text questions that an LLM turns into read-only SQL, runs and narrates, with dashboards and Excel export.

title: Brújula · Your numbers on WhatsApp
description: BI over WhatsApp: each rep gets their sales, goal and quotes twice a day, and the manager gets the team's daily close.

title: Núcleo · Your business in one screen
description: Serverless ERP for an events business: appointments synced both ways with Google Calendar, PDF quotes, suppliers, expenses and reports.

title: Vértice · A custom-built app
description: Full-stack, offline-first construction management: budgets, quotes by line item, progress with photos and payment requests checked by server rules.

title: Vitrina · Your online store
description: Complete online store: category catalog, instant search, reviews, a cart with discounts, checkout, and prices and stock synced from the ERP.

title: MyAccountant · Your money, in order
description: Personal finance PWA by pay period: 50/30/20 envelopes, a daily limit with a reserve, bills, reminders and 3D pets that grow with your savings.

title: Landing page · Audiovisual portfolio
description: Live landing page and audiovisual portfolio: billboard hero, video rows with hover previews, integrated player and SEO.

title: Festo · Automatic birthday wishes
description: Every morning it checks whose birthday it is and sends a WhatsApp greeting with a card. Retries at midday without duplicates.

title: Pulso · Offline-first surveys
description: Kiosk-mode satisfaction surveys that work with no signal: saved on the device, synced automatically and shown on a real-time dashboard.

title: Totem · Control your billboard screen
description: Digital signage: the totem plays a weather-matched video with a promo message; text, schedules and videos are managed from a phone.

title: Web Studio
description: Local AI video editor: describe the idea and it builds an editable multitrack timeline; exports to MP4, Premiere or DaVinci.

title: Distrito
description: Sales gamification PWA for store reps: missions, leagues, a 3D pet and rewards, with customers prioritized by RFM and a predictive model over the ERP.

title: Ruta Clara
description: Street-level delivery routes with per-turn costs, vehicle restrictions, loading plans, driver GPS and customer tracking.

title: Ourway
description: Private travel atlas: a 3D globe drops into a map where the route rebuilds itself from your photos' location and time.

title: Radar
description: Commercial analytics: reads the ERP in one pass, ranks customers and quotes with a visible formula and searches in milliseconds.

title: Inferencia eficiente
description: An LLM quantization lab for 4 GB GPUs: GPTQ makes INT4 and INT3 near-lossless and breaks the INT2 wall (from 2,588× down to 12.45×).

title: Obra Maestra MN
description: Unity 2D platformer compiled to WebGL: gather materials in building order, open finish packs and complete your house. PWA with leaderboard.

title: CORA · Conversational AI Assistant
description: AI assistant on WhatsApp: understands text, voice and images, quotes real ERP prices as a PDF and hands off to a person when needed.
